cards.title: First-star intrinsic spin-orbit estimate
cards.latex: 2 Delta_so=4 pi^2 e^2 hbar^2/(3 m^2 c^2 a^3) approximately 2.4 K

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 4, Eq. (7) and first-star paragraph

checks.reason: The first-star estimate and 2.4 K result are printed on p. 4.
The expression has dimensions of energy and is converted to kelvin through k_B.

open_questions: The estimate is explicitly described as crude and depends on the first-star approximation.

cards.title: Perpendicular-field Rashba estimate
cards.role: lambda_R much smaller than intrinsic gap
cards.latex: lambda_R=hbar v_F e E_z/(4 m c^2) approximately 0.5 mK for E_z approximately 50 V/300 nm
derived_from: Pauli spin-orbit coupling in an external electric field
cards.numerical_form: SI-unit estimate with declared v_F reference range

checks.reason: The formula, electric field and 0.5 mK estimate are printed on p. 4.
Using v_F near 10^6 m/s gives the printed sub-millikelvin scale.

open_questions: The paper does not print the exact v_F used in the 0.5 mK rounding.

cards.title: Coulomb RG flow and self-consistent renormalized gap

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 4, Eq. (8) and following paragraph

cards.numerical_form: positive scalar root in a common energy unit

checks.reason: The RG equations, integrated form and 15 K estimate are printed on p. 4.
Direct integration of the coupled flows yields the printed squared logarithm.
g0=.74, Lambda0=2 eV and bare full gap 2.4 K define a unique enhanced positive gap.

open_questions: The printed approximation does not state whether the self-consistency argument uses the half-gap or full gap convention; both will be audited.
